messages.author: 34d1b12964c01466
messages.subject: Leaflet conflict with shinydashboard?
parts:
The MRE below displays some odd behavior:

- Run as-is, it displays two valueBoxOutput on the good ol mtcars dataset

- However, if we uncomment the renderLeaflet function at the end of the server block (lines 46 - 49), the valueBoxOutputs disappear AND the map fails to render

Any diagnosis is appreciated.

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(leaflet)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)


mycars <- mtcars


## Assign some random coordinates to mtcars to draw on a map
mycars$lon <- runif(n_distinct(rownames(mtcars)), min = -110, max = -80)
mycars$lat <- runif(n_distinct(rownames(mtcars)), min = 30, max = 45)


ui <-  dashboardPage(
        dashboardHeader(title = "mtcars"),
        dashboardSidebar(),
        dashboardBody(
          fluidRow(
            valueBoxOutput("count"),
            valueBoxOutput("disp")
            ),
          fluidRow(
            box(
              width = 9, status = "info", solidHeader = TRUE,
              title = "Property Map",
              leafletOutput("myMap")
            )
         )
))


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$count <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(
      value = n_distinct(rownames(mtcars)),
      subtitle = "# cars",
      color = "blue"
    )
  })
 
  output$disp <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(
      value = sum(mtcars$disp, na.rm = TRUE),
      subtitle = "Total displacement",
      color = "green"
    )
  })
#   output$myMap <- renderLeaflet({
#     leaflet(mycars) %>% addTiles() %>% addCircleMarkers()
#   })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)

messages.subject: Re: Leaflet conflict with shinydashboard?
parts:
Can you try also upgrading these:

devtools::install_github(c("ramnathv/htmlwidgets", "rstudio/shiny"))
install.packages("jsonlite")

I think this is happening because of a low level JSON change we had to make to both Shiny and htmlwidgets, that requires them to be somewhat synchronized. This will hopefully be resolved in the next week or two, in the meantime if you upgrade one without the other and use an htmlwidget in a Shiny app this may happen.

We're very sorry for the inconvenience (we wouldn't have changed the JSON if we felt like we had a choice).
